Harvard-IIT Graduate Quits Corporate Job, Seeks Meaning

A graduate from Harvard and IIT, who worked a 9-to-5 job for ten years, has decided to quit. She stated that she is not in a hurry to return to her previous career path. The graduate is reflecting on the meaning of life after leaving her decade-long corporate role. Her decision has gained attention, with reports highlighting her educational background and her current perspective on her career.
